title: RunManifest
description: Provenance manifest of one finished run (03 §12): ids, code commit, environment, config/uv.lock/calibration hashes, input and output file hashes, AI provenance and per-step output hashes, with no timestamps or timings (P3). Written by core at the manifest step, after Causivra's card (10a) and before the receipt (10b), which embeds it.

run_id.description: Run id: first 16 hex of SHA-256 over (case_id, config_sha256, code.commit, ai.mode), plus -x<12 hex> for a derived verify_hypothesis run.

commit.description: Code commit that enters run_id: the git HEAD sha; "<sha>+dirty.<12 hex>" when the tree is dirty (the 12 hex hash the diff and untracked files under packages/, contracts/, config/, excluding config/calibration/, bench/results/ and runs/); "fixture" in golden fixtures; "unknown" outside a git checkout. Reported by replay, never compared.

dirty.description: True if the work tree had uncommitted or untracked changes under packages/, contracts/ or config/ (config/calibration/, bench/results/ and runs/ excluded), or the code is not a git checkout; dirty runs are marked and never used for paper tables.

env.title: RunManifestEnv
env.description: Runtime environment. Replay exit 5 compares Python major.minor and libs (with uv_lock_sha256); os is reported, never compared, so a Windows-recorded receipt replays on Linux CI.

os.description: Operating system, platform.system() lowercased (e.g. linux, windows, darwin). Reported only.

libs.description: Distribution name -> installed version for core's fixed list of analysis-relevant distributions (the same list on every platform). Free keys; canonical JSON sorts them.

config_sha256.description: SHA-256 of the config.lock.json file bytes (the fully resolved config written into the run dir).

uv_lock_sha256.description: SHA-256 of uv.lock after CRLF -> LF normalisation.

calibration_sha256.description: SHA-256 of the calibration file bytes; for an uncalibrated run the sentinel sha256_json({"family":"uncalibrated"}), the same value as verdict.calibration.sha256.

inputs.description: Raw case inputs, copied from case_manifest.inputs (name and sha256); sorted by name. Empty for synth.

outputs.description: Every artifact in the run dir except run_manifest.json, receipt.json and receipt.json.minisig, sorted by name; includes config.lock.json, card.md, agent_trace.jsonl and each cassette/ file. Built from known paths only.

ai.description: AI provenance, merged by core from the ai_manifest of every engine that called an LLM (Relentra, Causivra). With mode off every other field is null (enforced by the if/then below).

steps.description: Per-step record of the sub-steps that ran before this manifest was written, in pipeline order (infralume ... causivra.card, then manifest); causivra.receipt runs afterwards and is not listed. Lets reuse and replay check per-step hashes (e.g. evidence.parquet after faultloom and after faultloom.claim_pass).

RunManifestAI.title: RunManifestAI
RunManifestAI.description: AI provenance, merged by core from the ai_manifest of every engine that called an LLM (Relentra, Causivra). With mode off every other field is null (enforced by the if/then below).

mode.description: AI mode of the run (a run parameter that enters run_id, not a config key).

provider.description: LLM provider; must agree across engines.

model.description: Model name; must agree across engines.

gguf_sha256.description: SHA-256 of the model GGUF file; must agree across engines.

prompt_sha256.description: manifest_hash over every engine's prompt files, named <engine>/<file> and hashed after CRLF -> LF.

schema_sha256.description: manifest_hash over every engine's constrained-decoding schemas, named <engine>/<purpose>.

cassette_sha256.description: manifest_hash over the files under cassette/, computed by core after step 10a.

RunManifestFile.title: RunManifestFile
RunManifestFile.description: One file and the SHA-256 of its bytes.

name.description: Run-dir path, relative POSIX (forward slashes, no leading slash, no backslash), e.g. signal_cube/series.parquet or cassette/index.json.

RunManifestInput.title: RunManifestInput
RunManifestInput.description: One raw case input copied from case_manifest.inputs: its name and the SHA-256 of its bytes.

name.description: Relative name <source>/<basename>, the same value as case_manifest.inputs[].name (e.g. traces/traces.parquet).

RunManifestStep.title: RunManifestStep
RunManifestStep.description: One pipeline sub-step and the files it wrote.

name.description: Sub-step name from the fixed pipeline order.

status.description: Step result status (EngineResult.status): skipped is written by the runner (e.g. relentra with AI off); a failed step stops the run, so no manifest is written.

outputs.description: Files this step wrote, as run-dir paths with the SHA-256 of their bytes right after the step, sorted by name; empty for a skipped step. The manifest step lists config.lock.json only (run_manifest.json cannot hash itself).
